verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable from the vendor at vercel.com/openapi.json and contains an "openapi" key. It is a Vercel-wide spec, and nothing in the pack shows that it covers Vercel Sandbox endpoints; the Sandbox docs point to SDKs and a CLI instead. missing for 10: evidence that the spec includes Sandbox APIs, first-party Sandbox docs referencing the spec, independent corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://vercel.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
